subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

We were **__disillusioned__** when we saw how the movie star acted in real life.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"disillusioned"** means having lost faith or trust in something, especially because it does not meet expectations. (भ्रम-भंग होना)

 
 
• **Example: **After the scandal, many supporters felt **disillusioned** with the politician.
 
 
 
• **"Disenchanted"** refers to being disappointed by someone or something previously respected or admired; losing one's illusions. (मोहभंग)
 
 
• **Example: **She became **disenchanted** with her job after realizing there was no room for growth.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deluded** (विभ्रमित): Believing something that is not true.

 
 
• **Example:** He was deluded into thinking he could win the lottery.
 
 
 
• **Fooled** (धोखा देना): To deceive or trick someone.
 
 
• **Example:** She fooled him into believing she was a famous actress.
 
 
 
• **Misrepresented** (गलत तरीके से प्रस्तुत करना): To give a false or misleading account of the nature of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The media misrepresented the facts of the case.
 
 

30:Tc78,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
